title: Classify each element of an array via a lookup table
purpose: Iterate an array, mapping a code on each element through a lookup table, and emit one output row per element.
notes: An output section ending in [] becomes a loop: _loop = "@" with _from = "policies" iterates that source array.
Inside the loop, @.field reads the current element (here @.number and @.statusCode).
Uniform rows are emitted as a compact tabular block ({policies[] : number, status}).

avoid.why: inside a loop use @.field for the current element; @policies.number reads the source root, not the element
